t:
No part of any appropriation contained in this Act shall remain available for obligation beyond the current fiscal year unless expressly so provided herein.
This Act may be cited as the “Public Works Appropriation Act, 1967”.

fable.w: This section only limits the availability of appropriated funds to the current fiscal year and gives the Act its short title. No party outside the federal government is consulted, heard, or given any right to sue or object, and there is no rulemaking, hearing, or advisory body. Nothing here is even a tempting indicator of participation.
fable.s: No part of any appropriation contained in this Act shall remain available for obligation beyond the current fiscal year unless expressly so provided herein.

qwen_block.w: This section is a standard appropriations clause limiting the availability of funds to the current fiscal year. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or interaction with parties outside the federal government. It is purely an internal budgetary constraint.
qwen_block.s: No part of any appropriation contained in this Act shall remain available for obligation beyond the current fiscal year unless expressly so provided herein.

opus.w: This is standard appropriations boilerplate: it limits how long funds stay available and gives the Act's short title. It brings no party from outside the federal government into any federal decision. The title "Public Works" might suggest public involvement, but that is just a name and sets up no consultation, hearing, comment period, or advisory body.
opus.s: No part of any appropriation contained in this Act shall remain available for obligation beyond the current fiscal year unless expressly so provided herein.
opus.b: Step 1: The words "Public Works" and "Appropriation" might make this look like a federal decision with outside stakeholders, but that reading doesn't hold up. The text only limits how long appropriated money stays available and gives the Act's short title. No one outside the federal government is consulted, and there is no hearing, comment period, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue.

qwen_chat.w: This section is standard appropriations language limiting the availability of funds to the current fiscal year. It does not establish any process for consultation, comment, or participation by non-federal entities. The citation title is also merely administrative and does not imply a participatory process.
qwen_chat.s: No part of any appropriation contained in this Act shall remain available for obligation beyond the current fiscal year unless expressly so provided herein.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that "Public Works" implies public involvement or that the act itself is a result of legislative participation. However, the text provided is purely administrative boilerplate regarding the expiration of funds and the citation title of the Act. It contains no mechanism for outside parties to consult, comment, or participate in any decision-making process.
